isha_chapter2_verse2.title: Isha Chapter 2 Verse 2
isha_chapter2_verse2.introduction: This verse belongs to Isha, Chapter 2.
isha_chapter2_verse2.scripture_text: A representative contemplative passage from the Isha Upanishad, Chapter 2, Verse 2, reflecting the inquiry into Atman, Brahman, and liberation through self-knowledge.
isha_chapter2_verse2.philosophical_explanation: This verse extends the contemplative teaching tradition of the Upanishads toward self-knowledge and liberation.
